raw_response: {"diagnosis": "27 txn_ids in raw_transactions were delivered twice in batch 14, once as record_version 1 and once as record_version 2, with different amounts. silver_transactions does not deduplicate, so 25 POSTED keys are duplicated and the gold tables double-count those transactions. The record_version column marks the later version as the correction, so keeping the highest version per txn_id restores one row per key.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.74, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) t WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
